ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
PyGraphistry is a Python library for graph visualization, analytics, and AI,
with optional GPU acceleration. It turns dataframes (pandas, Apache Arrow,
RAPIDS cuDF) into interactive visualizations of graphs with millions of edges,
queries graphs with GFQL (Cypher syntax or Python chains), and connects to
graph databases and data platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Databricks,
and Splunk. This conda package installs the core dependencies only; optional
pip extras such as graphistry[ai], graphistry[umap-learn], graphistry[networkx],
and graphistry[igraph] are not included and must be installed separately.

name: graphistry
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: graphistry
  version: "0.62.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/graphistry-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7210caee57680c6f85b5cdaf2bfb54f715a56f5e5987f1cbca15e52f5b97c4ab

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy
    - palettable >=3.0
    - pandas
    - lark >=1.1,<2
    - pyarrow >=0.15.0
    - requests
    - typing_extensions
    - packaging >=20.1
    - setuptools

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - graphistry
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  summary: A visual graph analytics library.
  description: |
    PyGraphistry is a Python library for graph visualization, analytics, and AI,
    with optional GPU acceleration. It turns dataframes (pandas, Apache Arrow,
    RAPIDS cuDF) into interactive visualizations of graphs with millions of edges,
    queries graphs with GFQL (Cypher syntax or Python chains), and connects to
    graph databases and data platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Databricks,
    and Splunk. This conda package installs the core dependencies only; optional
    pip extras such as graphistry[ai], graphistry[umap-learn], graphistry[networkx],
    and graphistry[igraph] are not included and must be installed separately.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://github.com/graphistry/pygraphistry
  repository: https://github.com/graphistry/pygraphistry
  documentation: https://pygraphistry.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
